prompts.idle:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production animation keyframe sheet for FREYJA web application pet, a replacement for its sparse idle animation.
Input image is the approved existing mascot sheet and the exact identity/costume/rendering reference. Preserve this same silver-white long-haired chibi girl, violet eyes, curled forelock, two purple flower clips with gold star centers, purple cape with gold trim, white ruffled dress and purple ankle boots. Preserve the face, proportions, ornament positions and polished anime cel shading. Clean alpha edges.
Create ONE genuinely transparent PNG sprite sheet, exactly SIXTEEN complete full-body figures in an EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows evenly spaced grid. Read sequential frames left to right, then top to bottom. Every cell has equal size. No labels, lines, checkerboard, scenery, ground shadows, floating icons or watermark. All figures fully contained within their cell with ample transparent gutters. Identical camera, character scale, frontal three-quarter view and fixed feet baseline at 90% of cell height. Character occupies about 78% of each cell's height and at most 86% of width.
These are SIXTEEN consecutive frames of one subtle seamless idle breathing loop, NOT alternate poses or character designs. Both hands remain clasped gently in front, feet stay planted and torso scale stays fixed. Frame 1: relaxed starting pose eyes open. Frames 2-5: gradually inhale, shoulders lift very slightly, hair ends drift gently right; changes between adjacent frames are tiny. Frames 6-8: exhale gradually toward neutral, eyes remain open. Frame 9: eyes begin to close, frame 10: half closed, frame 11: fully closed soft blink, frame 12: half open, frame 13: open. Frames 14-16: settle hair and shoulders smoothly back to frame 1, so frame 16 connects naturally to frame 1. Keep smiles and mouth shape constant. Hair and clothes move only subtly; no whole-body shaking, no large head tilts, no jumping. Face size and ornaments remain exactly stable through the sequence.
This is animation artwork for a small desktop-like window pet. The priority is tiny successive changes, stable identity, and smooth temporal continuity. Output at high resolution, square canvas, actual transparent background.
